basis.name: Tonbo Imaging India Limited
basis.brlm: JM Financial Limited; IIFL Capital Services Limited
basis.outside: Subscription and anchor size from NSE; anchor investor names from secondary press reports (unverified)

cites.ctax: p. 89 (FY24 incl. MAT credit Rs 15.02 m)
cites.rpt_p: pp. 94-95 (excludes the Rs 1,831.91 m IP purchase in FY24 and Rs 70.98 m intangibles in FY26)
cites.cl: p. 92 (bank guarantees Rs 789.34 m + GST disputes Rs 8.32 m at 30-Jun-2026)

1.finding: 19:1 bonus (30-Jun-2025) and split from Rs 10 to Rs 2 are reflected: diluted EPS 13.63 / 12.70 / 8.88 FY24-26 and NAV Rs 96.57 are on the post-bonus, post-split count of 57,282,100 shares.

3.finding: Current tax (incl. MAT) Rs 615.64 m on cumulative PBT Rs 2,637.74 m FY24-26 = 23.3%; deferred tax is a small share of the charge.

4.finding: IP bought from CEAQ Singapore (formerly Tonbo Imaging Pte; an enterprise with substantial interest, selling shareholder) for Rs 1,831.91 m in Mar-2024, valued by DCF (MPEEM, 10-year life) and capitalised: 54.4% of FY24 total expenses. Material purchases from CEAQ Singapore continue: Rs 789.80 m in FY26 (26.3% of total expenses) and Rs 171.99 m in Q1 FY27 (28.2%).

5.finding: Pure offer for sale; the company receives no proceeds, so there is no objects floor.

7.finding: No goodwill. Intangible assets Rs 1,627.01 m at 31-Mar-2026 = 29.4% of net worth, mostly the related-party IP purchase; amortisation lifts D&A from Rs 133.95 m (FY24) to Rs 313.35 m (FY26).

8.finding: Top-10 customers 77.83% of FY26 revenue and 98.17% in Q1 FY27 (top-1 54.74%); Indian Government 71.19% of FY26 revenue; foreign-government revenue fell from Rs 2,676.93 m to Rs 121.14 m. Top-10 suppliers 68.77% of FY26 total expenses with no long-term supply contracts.

9.finding: Bank guarantees Rs 789.34 m = 14.7% of 30-Jun-2026 net worth; GST disputes Rs 8.32 m; a customs notice received 23-Jul-2026 is disclosed as a contingent liability without an amount. Materiality threshold Rs 32.03 m (p. 447).

R1.finding: Kalyanasundaram and Associates (FRN 005455S); no auditor change in three years; no qualifications, reservations or emphasis of matter; audit-trail (Rule 11(g)) operated throughout.

R6.finding: Track record of JM Financial and IIFL Capital compiled from the RHP's exchange-sourced tables (see merchant banker section).

R2.finding: Auditor confirms the audit-trail (edit log) feature operated throughout for all relevant transactions and was not tampered with (Rule 11(g)). CARO remarks not reviewed separately.

R3.finding: Pure offer for sale; no proceeds to the company, so no monitoring agency is required.

rationale.g1: FY26 revenue fell 22.69% to Rs 3,626.48 m (p. 144). Order book Rs 3,142.40 m at 30-Jun-2026 (0.87x FY26 revenue) plus Rs 1,181.52 m of orders received Jul-Sep 2026 (p. 250), incl. a Rs 514.41 m export order deferred from FY26 (p. 23). Q1 FY27 revenue only Rs 360.08 m. Bear: slow execution; Neutral: FY27 back near FY25; Bull: full conversion of the book.
rationale.m: EBITDA margin 26.23% / 29.65% / 28.85% FY24-26 (p. 144); Q1 FY27 -36.21% on low revenue. Bear 22% allows for price pressure in tenders; Neutral ~3-year average; Bull at the FY25 high.
rationale.nwc: Trade NWC (inventory + receivables - trade payables) 43.2% / 64.0% / 109.7% of revenue FY24-26 (p. 87); issuer's working-capital days 152 / 280 / 517 (p. 144). Neutral assumes a partial unwind as the inventory built for FY27 orders is delivered.
rationale.roic: ROCE 67.76% / 27.41% / 14.54% FY24-26 on the issuer's definition, which excludes intangibles (p. 144). Terminal ROIC set at 14% in Neutral because the purchased IP is part of invested capital.
